name: Lily of the Valley
description: A champion of holly said to have wielded the sword Cragflame against the Calamity Beasts, and Mabel's many-greats-grandmother.

timeline.summary: Oliver reassures the guests that Calamity Beasts do not trouble Valley, while Helga recalls the history of weavers and Lily of the Valley.
timeline.quote: The unpredictable ones, the Blight Snake and the Drought Cat and so on, don't intrude on the affairs of us little folk in Valley.
